description:

The Bubble Brothers Circus is coming to town, and all the Guppies are getting into the act: Goby the clown, Gil the acrobat, and Oona the lion tamer.

description:

When Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, they help take the cat home to Meownt Rushmore.

description:

City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.

description:

Jesters Goby and Gil arrive in the Kingdom of NeverLaugh, where King Grumpfish decrees that he'll outlaw laughter if no one can make him laugh before sundown.

description:
S05 E10 — Dragons N' Roses!
When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

It's Team Flightless versus cocky Amelia the peregrine falcon; though Penguin Nonny, Ostrich Oona, and Kiwi Goby can't fly, these birds of a feather flock together; teamwork must be enough for them to win the race.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Molly and Gil meet Farmer Joe and all the cool barnyard animals on his farm; when Farmer Joe's cute baby lamb wanders off during a big swirling popcorn storm, Bubble Puppy has to become a sheepdog and herd her back to safety!

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E05 — Winter Sports Chompetition!
Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Peppa Pig
description:

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Swimming Lesson; Water Park; Canoe Trip; The Holiday; Sea Treasure
Rabbit is the instructor for swimming lessons, everyone helps teach Mummy Rabbit how to swim; Peppa and friends are going to a water park; Peppa and her family are going for a canoe trip; Peppa and her family go on a trip to a holiday home.

title: Peppa Pig
description:

Pedro Pony is having a superhero birthday party; Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house; Peppa is having a lesson outside; Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog take the kids bowling; Peppa and Suzy Sheep help Dr. Hamster the Vet.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E08 — Pups Pit Crew; Pups Fight Fire
Ryder and the PAW Patrol must rescue Alex when he takes off on his new super trike; Marshall proves he is a true hero when he stops during a competition to put out a fire on the beach.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E02 — Pups Save the Space Alien; Pups Save a Flying Frog
The PAW Patrol helps an extra-terrestrial after his spaceship crash lands at Farmer Yumi's place; the Pups come to the rescue when Smiley the frog jumps into Skye's helicopter.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E11 — The Crew and Marshall Build a Fire Station
Rubble & Crew build Builder Cove's first ever Fire Station, complete with an inspection from PAW Patrol's Marshall; when Speed Meister's sneaky sabotage traps Marshall's Fire Truck, the pups work together to put out a fire construction-style.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E25 — Pups Raise the PAW Patroller; Pups Save the Crows
When Daring Danny sinks the PAW Patroller, the pups must find a way to raise their rig; the pups team up with Alex's mini patrol to retrieve mysteriously missing items.

title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
description:
S07 E26 — The Robot Championship
It's the Robot Championship, and only the fastest, strongest and smartest robot will win; using coding, Blaze tries to win enough sports to take home the trophy.

title: Santiago of the Seas
description:
S02 E18 — The Secret Room; Little Shrimp, Big Problems
After commandeering the new clubhouse for himself, Pepito traps the Pirate Protectors inside a secret room that they can only escape from if they work together as friends; the grand opening of Martin's paleta shop is almost ruined.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E22 — Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E12 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Meet the Mighty Twins
When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E26 — Pups and the Pirate Treasure
Cap'n Turbot stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout; the PAW Patrol searches for clues to find the missing pieces of a treasure map.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E01 — Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Stop a Humdinger Horde; Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Save a Mighty Lighthouse
The Mighty Pups have to save the day when Harold makes a cloning machine; Harold uses his superpowers to turn Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse into a rocket.

title: DORA
description:
Captain Dora; Bruno And The Bunny Boyz
Dora takes charge as a bold captain to help the Pirate Piggies save a ship in trouble; Dora supports Bruno as preparation begins for a Bunny Boyz performance.

title: DORA
description:
The Missing Magical Instruments; Mr. Banana's Big Puppet Show
Dora, Boots and Vicky the Vicuna must find lost musical instruments to save Sky Kingdom; Dora rescues Boots' special banana doll before the golden marmosets get their hands on it.

description:
Danny's Pirate Bedroom; Undersea Party; Woodland Club; Guinea Pigs; Bird Spotting

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Recycling; The Boat Pond; Traffic Jam; Bedtime; Sports Day

description:

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Strawberries; Pizza! Pizza!; Grandpa Pig's Birthday; Pancakes; Teddy's Day Out
Grandpa and Granny Pig have been growing strawberries; Peppa and family make pizzas; Peppa and her family celebrate Grandpa Pig's birthday; Daddy Pig thinks he's an expert pancake maker; Peppa loses Teddy at a picnic.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E25 — Rubble and Wild in a Yarn of a Tail; Skye and Rory Flip It; Marshall and Leo Save the Ferris Wheel Passengers; Everest and Shade Save a Mountain Goat
Rubble and Wild team up to stop a giant runaway yarn ball rolling through town; Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E05 — Pups Save Their Digi-Tal Friends; Pups Save the Rainbow
The PAW Patrol must save the day when two overly helpful robots take on more than they can handle; in a dream, Mayor Humdinger finds a prism that makes rainbows and drains Adventure Bay of color; the pups must restore color to Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E18 — Pups Save Little Hairy; Pups Save a Kooky Climber
Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole, and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy; Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E03 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Sunken Sloop; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Wiggly Whale
Sid the Pirate and his first mate, Arrby, take the sunken sloop; a wiggling whale knocks the diving bell to the bottom of the ocean, with Cap'n Turbot and Francois trapped inside.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E22 — Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies; Pups Save the Greenhouse
Humdinger's hands are full when he babysits his new friend's kids; Everest helps the pups rescue both mayors trapped inside a greenhouse.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E09 — Air Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-stronaut
Captain Gordy and his space shuttle are blasting off from the Adventure Bay Airport with a satellite! But when Mayor Humdinger sneaks on board to snap a couple of selfies, the space shuttle blasts off with him still inside! Air Rescue pups save him.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E18 — Pups Save an Adventure; Pups Save a Surprise
The PAW Patrol joins Alex and Mr. Porter at their campsite and teaches them how to safely build and extinguish a camp fire; while rescuing Chickaletta from the top of City Hall, the pups notice that it has been decorated for a big celebration.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E16 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Shark; Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Pier
Humdinger makes a robotic shark to scare everyone away from the beach; the pups come to the rescue when the pier has a broken support post.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
The Crew Builds a Conveyor Belt Restaurant; The Crew Makes a Community Soup
Rubble and Crew want to help open a new restaurant for everyone at the Buddy Walk Race, but they can't decide what kind of restaurant to build!; when Grandpa Gravel is feeling under the weather, Rubble and Crew step in to make his signature soup.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E17 — The Crew Celebrates BuilderCovegiving Day; The Crew Builds a Rocket Ship Ride
After Speed Meister sabotages Family, Friends and Fun Day, it's up to the pups to save the holiday for everyone in Builder Cove; Mix dreams about giving the moon a Mix makeover.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E05 — Pups Save a Humdinger Doll; Pups Save a Sand Sculpture Contest
The PAW Patrol must rescue Mayor Humdinger; Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay sand sculpture contest.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E11 — Air Rescue: Pups vs. the Hum-Cloud; Air Rescue: Pups Stop the Mid-Air Magnet
Humdinger tries to sabotage the Air Rescue Pups' Air Show; Uncle Otis' powerful magnetic drone goes rogue and starts picking up every metal object in sight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E22 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Frozen Flounder; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Narwhal
Cap'n Turbot's boat gets frozen in the Arctic ice; the pups use the Sea Patroller to help guide a lost narwhal back home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E23 — Pups Save the Gliding Turbots; Pups Save a Plane
When Francois and Cap'n Turbot get stranded on a remote island, Ryder and the pups must fly in to rescue the bickering cousins; the pups must come to the rescue when Mayor Goodway's first flying lesson goes awry.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E15 — Pups vs. the Robo-Ducky; Pups Save the Lost Penguin
Digi and Tal build a big Robo-Ducky that runs amok through Adventure Bay; when Mayor Goodway tries to catch a glimpse of a migrating penguin colony, her precious Chickaletta and a Baby Penguin accidentally switch places.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E05 — Pups Save the Mustache; Pups Save the Funhouse
The Pups must help to find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off; after a carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.

description:

The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.

Molly and the Guppies want to learn how to tell a story through dance.

It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.

description:

The Guppies perform a "soap opera" to teach Mr. Grouper about good hygiene.

description:

When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.

description:

description:

Peppa teases George; Mummy Pig makes pancakes; Peppa and George hear a strange noise; Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera; Peppa's friends ride their bicycles.

title: Peppa Pig
description:

Peppa's family goes for a cycle ride; Peppa and George play in their tree house; the postman's daughter helps him; the cuckoo clock is broken; Peppa and George go ice skating.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E02 — Pups Meet the Cat Pack
When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature.

description:
S05 E14 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Tigers
When searching for elusive rumble top tigers, the Turbots fall into a cave deep inside a volcano; the PAW Patrol performs a paratrooper-style rescue from Skye's ultimate copter.

When a windy day derails construction on an ice cream shop, Rubble & Crew are on the chase; there's a mysterious squeak in City Hall, so Mayor Greatway asks Rubble and Charger to find and fix the squeak before her big speech.

description:

Crusher takes Gabby's remote that can control any machine and uses it to activate machines all over town to slow Blaze down.

description:

When Santiago and his crew race to protect the magical Stones of Power from being taken by Bonnie Bones, they receive a little help from their hero, Capitán Calavera.

S07 E21 — Pups Save a Trash-Dinger; Pups Save the Royal Armor
When Mayor Humdinger's trash-compacting truck messes up the beach, Rocky's new Re-Use It Truck comes to the rescue; when a gift of armor for the Princess gets scattered all over town, Rocky uses his Re-Use It Truck to put the armor back together.

description:

Dora is about to give her pets a bath when the pet-washing truck goes haywire, and she has to save pets throughout the rainforest; Dora and Boots save a mouse, just in time for him to show off his giant kite at the Rainforest Kite Fest.

description:
Chloe's Puppet Show; Babysitting; My Birthday Party; Daddy Gets Fit; New Shoes
Peppa's family visits Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe; Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit; the family celebrates Peppa's birthday; Daddy Pig likes to watch; Mummy Pig buys Peppa a pair of shoes.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Rescuing Miss Rabbit!; Peppa's Diary; Playing Golf; Creepy Crawly Safari; Buried Treasure
Miss Rabbit needs rescuing; Peppa finds out Mummy Pig used to keep a diary; Peppa and George are being taught how to play golf; the playgroup visits a nature reserve; Peppa and her friends find a box of pirate treasure.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Health Check; Potty Training; Jelly; The Tractor; The Petting Farm
Peppa goes to the doctor; mummy and daddy teach George how to use a potty; Daddy Pig shows Peppa how to make jelly; Mrs. Badger shows Peppa how a tractor works; Peppa visits the petting farm.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Hearing Test; Favorite Sound; Hospital Sleepover; Caring for Grandpa Pig; Granny Sheep Moves In
During a hearing test, Peppa and her family find out George needs a hearing aid; now that George can hear much better with his new hearing aid, Peppa makes it her mission to show him her favorite sounds!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E24 — Pups Save a Pizza; Pups Save Skye
While delivering special pizza dough for a party, Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident; a storm causes Skye to crash-land in the snow while on her way to Jake's Mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E20 — Pups Get Skunked; Pups and a Whale of a Tale
When Everest gets sprayed by a skunk, the pups tell her delicately that she needs a bath; the pups fly north to help free a baby whale that is trapped under the ice.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E06 — Pups Save Jake's Cake; Pups Save a Wild Ride
Ryder and the pups must help get a surprise birthday cake up to Jake's cabin; the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Alex and Daring Danny X snowboard toward Risky Ridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E04 — Pups Save Alex's Mini-Patrol; Pups Save a Lost Tooth
Alex sets up his own mini-patrol, recruiting Chickaletta, Cali, Turtle, and Bunny; Alex loses his first tooth and then misplaces it.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E26 — Pups Bark With Dinosaurs
The pups must catch three baby pterodactyls after they hatch from fossilized eggs unearthed on an excavation dig.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E24 — Pups Save Francois the Penguin; Pups Save Daring Danny's Hippo
Francois and a baby penguin get caught on the other side of a crevasse; Daring Danny wants a cool pet of his own.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E06 — Pups Save Friendship Day
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E10 — Pups Save the PawPaws; Pups Save a Popped Top
Carlos and Tracker make PawPaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble; Farmer Al needs help saving his corn crop after the top of his silo gets knocked off.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S03 E04 — The Crew Builds a Super Mega Movie Screen; The Crew Builds an Auntie Day Present
A new Super Squirrelly Whirly movie is playing at the drive-in theater. When Speed Meister gets in the way, the pups spring into action to save the day. It's Auntie Day, but can the pups finish building their present for Auntie Crane in time?

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E02 — The Crew Builds a Santa's Village; The Crew Builds a Giant Dreidel
Santa visits Builder Cove but is tricked by Speed Meister until Rubble and Crew save him; the team enhances Builder Cove's Hanukkah celebration by constructing a giant dreidel.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E03 — Pups Save a Melon Festival; Pups Save a Cow
Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his "melon" bounces away and causes chaos all over town; Farmer Al's truck gets stuck on a broken bridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E05 — Pups Save a Sleepover; Pups Save the Carnival
Farmer Al's animals go missing during a sleepover; Cornelius escapes from the pig ride at the carnival, and all the prizes have gone missing too.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E03 — Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers; Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Golden Lion Mask
Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket; when the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade and Wild must help the PAW Patrol to retrieve the stolen artifact.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E23 — Pups Save Luke Stars; Pups Save Chicken Day
When Luke Stars gets stuck on a ledge, Ryder and Marshall rush to the rescue; Mayor Goodway's big plans for Chicken Day become threatened when the Chicken of Honor, Chickaletta, mysteriously disappears.

title: Valiente: A Tracker Story
description: When Tracker and Carlos come across a series of nocturnal animals fleeing the scariest part of the region, the Shadow Jungle, Tracker, with the help from Ryder and the PAW Patrol, must brave his fear of the dark and stop a new villain, Lucita Mala.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E07 — Genie in a Bubble!
When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E13 — Too Bright for Movie Night!
If the Moon People can find a way to make it dark during the day, the Sun People agree to turn off their giant night light so the Moon People can enjoy their movie night.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E10 — The Jaw-some Sharkventure!
Zooli and her crew of marine biologists escort their new friends Baby Shark and his pilot fish, William, to visit Baby Shark's great-great-great-great-great Uncle Slow Mo and help them escape the determined fisherman who's chasing them.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E04 — Guppy Movers!
When their friend's moving day does not go as planned, Molly, Gil and the Guppy Movers head out to set things right in his new home.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E22 — Bubble Puppysaurus!
When small-town "puppy-saurus" Bubble Puppy gets picked to go against the reigning champ Boom Boom T. rex in the Tough Roarier competition, it's a battle of strength, speed and, above all, heart.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E25 — Super Guppies!
When Molly and Gil bring a comic book to school, the Guppies are inspired, and they all want to be superheroes.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

When giant robot Buster steals all the batteries that power Solar City, which runs on the sun's energy, it's up to solar power workers Nonny and Goby to stop him and get the lights back on before the big light show is cancelled.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E12 — Snow Squad to the Rescue!
Gil is convinced a yeti is to blame when sleeping bags go missing.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Molly, Gil and a duckling named Beep help a family of ducks that are lost in a storm cloud.

title: Bubble Guppies
